title: nerve-wml v1.8.0: Substrate-Agnostic Nerve Protocol with Axioms-Axis Integration
description: v1.8.0 release integrates the dream-of-kiki axioms axis (DR-0..DR-4 frozen Axiom dataclasses) as first-class inputs to the substrate-agnostic nerve protocol. The DR-2 weakened predicate (upstream amendment 2026-04-21, precondition excluding RESTRUCTURE-before-REPLAY permutations) is consumed automatically; downstream substrate handlers no longer need to re-derive the predicate. Strictly additive: the dict-based spec contract from v1.7.0 is preserved unchanged. The headline result is the GammaThetaMultiplexer (PR #2, merged 2026-04-20, master commit 77efb4d): biophysically realistic phase-coupled oscillation transport between heterogeneous neural components, gated by gamma-theta phase coherence, with no learned weights on the carrier itself. This is conceptually adjacent to but mathematically disjoint from the concurrent RecursiveLink projection (RecursiveMAS, Yang et al. arXiv:2604.25917, 2026-04-28); the convergence is discussed in dream-of-kiki Paper 2 (related work paragraph + rebuttal pocket). Eleven gates from v1.0.0 continue to validate: protocol correctness (Gate P), MLP-LIF polymorphism (Gate W), merge fine-tuning (Gate M), resolved scientific shortcuts (Gate M2), scaling (Gate Scale), neuroletter-semantics (Gate Interp), INT8 Loihi/Akida export (Gate Neuro), dream-of-kiki consolidation (Gate Dream partial), adaptive alphabet (Gate Adaptive), and micro-kiki LLM advisor (Gate LLM Advisor). PyPI release 2026-04-23. Cited in the parent research program's Paper 1 v0.2 PLOS CB submission (section 7.4 dreamOfkiki cross-substrate validation) and Paper 2 outline (sections 4.1-4.6 Conformance Criterion, section 5.1 SubstrateAdapter Protocol).
